statement: On the least rank-one cubic, the actual finite joint j-line level-three quotient admits Selmer lifting among every finite alteration of a nonzero integer exactly at that integer. Pure coefficient-three alterations of any integer, including0, are likewise exactly classified. Uniformly for elliptic CM cubic twists with rational infinity flex, any finite alteration of a nonzero integer with a changed prime other than3 is excluded, including coefficient2.
depends_on: A.67 actual character factorization and local3 identity; A.61 joint CM Kummer openness; prescribed-primary Frobenius lemma; good proper reduction and finite-etale division torsors; exact isogeny norm identity; fixed-S squareclass finiteness; Faltings1983 with1984 correction; exact order9/nonsquare witness at73
answers: A.12(b), Lead5 and the one-extra-prime mechanism: every nontrivial alteration at any one coefficient prime of a nonzero integer on the least curve is killed in the actual finite joint X3 quotient; simultaneous finite alterations are also excluded. Pure3 changes include baseline0.
notes: The prescribed-primary lemma is proved with an actual product neighbourhood in the joint Kummer image and is reapplied after each finite extension. After killing the global quadratic unit class in a fixed field, every torsion-translated unit radical must lie in the proper division tower or contradict Chebotarev. This gives even valuations outside one fixed S; unramifiedness, not odd extension degree, descends parity and handles p2. Norm_[p²]g=Cg propagates to infinitely many rational multiples and fixed genus2 twists, giving Faltings. For pure3, quadratic disjointness and the local3 translated-unit identity handle nonzero baselines; an exact9-torsion nonsquare at73 handles baseline0. Root and B independently audited the full chain. A.69 subsequently completes the finite-support baseline-zero theorem. No arbitrary infinite-alteration result, finite-fibre classification or full punctured-cover lifting equivalence is asserted.
